findings.current: I straightened up and even gave them a clasped-fist salute.
findings.defect: The Korean describes his posture as straight as a sword; “straightened up” drops that specific image, which the accepted baseline preserved.
findings.rationale: 칼 같은 자세 conveys a sword-straight posture, not merely the action of straightening up.
findings.replacement: I stood as straight as a sword and even gave them a clasped-fist salute.

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with one minor loss of a source-specific physical image.
